purpose: Teach: 巫女/出土/事変/病原/徴候/定式/諸氏/カルテル

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 地域の、本気で、絶対、巫女、絶対、伝統行事、絶対、当社、絶対、協賛しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need you to seriously consider becoming a sponsor for the local traditional miko festival. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Sharp, direct opening. Clipped cadence. Low register, authoritative. No room for negotiation in the tone. Lands firmly on the request.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業地から、本気で、絶対、出土、絶対、した、絶対、遺物、絶対、当社、絶対、歴史的価値、絶対、注目しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We've been closely monitoring the historical artifacts excavated from our founding site, and we recognize their significant cultural value. We're genuinely grateful for the opportunity.
lines.style: Measured, formal cadence. Each phrase deliberate and weighed. Respectful but competent — showing he understands the stakes. Slight emphasis on "genuinely."

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 歴史の、本気で、絶対、事変、絶対、を教訓に、絶対、当社、絶対、戦略を、絶対、立てろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Then use those historical lessons to sharpen our company strategy. I want you moving on this seriously.
lines.style: Pivot to firm direction. Slightly faster tempo than before. Expectation embedded in the phrasing. The tone of someone used to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。感染症、本気で、絶対、病原、絶対、菌、絶対、対策製品、絶対、当社、絶対、開発、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're actively advancing the development of countermeasure products targeting infectious pathogens. We appreciate your confidence in this direction.
lines.style: Steady professional report. Slightly faster pace — conveying forward momentum. Grateful without being deferential. Each milestone lands clearly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 市場縮小の、本気で、絶対、徴候、絶対、当社、絶対、早期、絶対、察知しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Watch for the first signs of market contraction. I need early warning systems in place. This is serious.
lines.style: Lowered pitch on "early warning." Slower, heavier emphasis. The gravity of a senior leader preparing for downturn. Not panicking, but vigilant.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業務フローの、本気で、絶対、定式、絶対、化、絶対、当社、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're standardizing our workflow processes across the company. We're making real progress on this.
lines.style: Confident, straightforward. Tempo slightly brisk — showing momentum. Pride in the work without overstatement. Factual and assured.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の、本気で、絶対、諸氏、絶対、と、絶対、連携、絶対、強化しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Strengthen our partnerships with industry leaders. Make it happen.
lines.style: Economical, clipped. No extra words. The tone of someone whose directives are final. Brief eye contact pause for emphasis.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界、本気で、絶対、カルテル、絶対、疑い、絶対、当社、絶対、関与しておりません、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. I want to assure you that we have no involvement whatsoever in any industry cartel activity. We're operating with complete transparency and integrity.
lines.style: Careful, deliberate pacing. Slight formality increase — the weight of legal/ethical assurance. Not defensive, but precise. Lands firmly on "no involvement."
